exit switches peer via eBGP
with external routers

Zone A - Partition A
own VNI space, own BGP underlay

Zone B - Partition B

No EVPN or VXLAN overlay is stretched between zones. Every partition is a self-contained CLOS fabric.

switch.text: No EVPN or VXLAN overlay is stretched between zones. Every partition is a self-contained CLOS fabric.

div.div: Cross-zone traffic is routed at Layer 3 through the exit switches. Inter-zone latency budget < 20 ms.
